name: intraday_direction_v1
dataset: aeron7 index minutes, importer aeron7-2 (external_verified); uses: direction_research, regime_research
not_for: no option prices: nothing here qualifies an option strategy, a DTE change, a paper gate, a promotion or a profitability claim
price_at: close of the 5-minute bar that ENDS at the named time (09:45 = the 09:40 bar's close); 'close' = the 15:25 bar's close; 'open' = the 09:15 bar's open

H1_intraday_momentum.why: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (2018, JFE): the first half hour's return, overnight included, predicts the last half hour's

H3_first_hour_continuation.why: intraday trend persistence after the first hour

H4_large_gap.why: gap fade or continuation after a large gap

H5_opening_range_breakout.signal: first 5-minute bar starting 09:45..13:55 closing above the 09:15-09:44 high (+1) or below its low (-1)

H6_momentum_high_vol.why: H1 in high volatility (momentum is stronger in volatile markets in Gao et al.)
H6_momentum_high_vol.filter: prior 20-session close-to-close realised vol in the top tercile of the dev period's distribution (threshold frozen from dev)

statistic: per test (hypothesis x symbol): r = signal x log return of the trade, one trade a day at most; mean in bps; t with Newey-West (5 lags); two-sided p
cost_hurdle: futures round trip in bps from autolearn.costs (CostModel.round_trip_bps at the median entry price), for scale only
dev_rule: a test is selected when its Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.05 across all 14 dev tests AND |mean| > the cost hurdle. Its direction (follow the signal, or fade it) is the sign of its dev mean, frozen
lock_rule: only selected tests are evaluated, once, on the lock period, in their frozen direction. A test passes when its one-sided p < 0.05 AND its mean net of the cost hurdle is > 0. A failure or no selection is reported as such; the lock is never reopened for this spec
reported: every test's dev statistics; every selected test's lock statistics; sessions per period; the spec's sha256
